content: Role highlights - Lead, Process Excellence & Controls - Location: Espoo, Finland - Department: Corporate Controlling & Accounting - Reports to: VP, Global Corporate Controller - Employment type: Permanent - Workplace model: Hybrid - Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) Why this role matters ICEYE is growing fast: new entities, new contracts, new currencies and new people every quarter. Our processes and controls need to grow with it, and the foundations are being built now. You will lead Process Excellence & Controls and report to the VP, Global Corporate Controller. You will own the company-wide control framework and help teams across the whole company document their processes and improve the control environment. If you want to build lasting process discipline, and not only run it, this is the role for you. About ICEYE ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world’s largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. ROLE HIGHLIGHTS: - Security Officer - Location: New Delhi, India - Department: ICEYE, India - Reports to: CEO, ICEYE India - Employment type: Permanent - Workplace model: Office - Employment is subject to applicable security screening. Appointment as CCSO under SMLDI 2025 is subject to Indian citizenship, police verification, DDP vetting (repeated every three years) and an Official Secrets Act undertaking. Start date depends on government vetting. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS: As the Security Officer, you’ll build ICEYE India’s security function from the ground up and serve as our appointed Company Chief Security Officer under India’s Security Manual for Licensed Defence Industries (SMLDI 2025). Your work allows ICEYE India to operate as a licensed defence company, pass government inspections and take part in classified programmes.
